text: Until 2026-10-08 the mmseqs at ~/bin/mmseqs on the 16-core x86_64 box was an aarch64 static build run through qemu-aarch64-static via binfmt_misc, about 5 to 8 times slower than native. Jack replaced it with the x86-64 build (same version 8cc5ce3) on 2026-10-08. Any mmseqs timing recorded on this box before then, including the Sep 28 100k-target run in nail-benchmarks/data/tmp-nail, was emulated.
